risk_if_not_implemented: Without Security, Compliance & Resilience Resource Management, security, compliance and resilience requirements may be omitted from projects and initiatives until late, costly stages. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, no risk is rated Likely; risks rated Possible include Business / Service Interruption (R-BC-1), Reduced Operational Productivity (R-BC-3), Regulatory / Legal / Contractual Financial Liability (R-EX-5), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9), Economic Shock / Market Disruption (MT-16).

compensating_control_1.name: Risk Management Program
compensating_control_1.description:
Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of strategic, operational and tactical risk management controls that are aligned with:
(1) The organization's Enterprise Risk Management (ERM); and
(2) Industry-recognized cybersecurity risk management practices.
compensating_control_1.justification: Risk Management Program (RSK-02) provides policy-level governance that compensates for the absence of Security, Compliance & Resilience Resource Management (PRM-05) by establishing documented expectations, accountability structures, and organizational guardrails. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Measures of Performance
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to develop, report and monitor Security, Compliance & Resilience Program (SCRP) measures of performance.
compensating_control_2.justification: Measures of Performance (GOV-12) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Security, Compliance & Resilience Resource Management (PRM-05) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Process applicability. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
